Subject: Zephyr pilot kickoff: mutual action plan and legal cadence

Hi Irene / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — the pilot looks promising and we'd like to move to a formal MAP so our procurement and legal teams can line up approvals. Key items from our side:

- 2-week technical evaluation (start: Aug 17)
- Security review: SOC 2 evidence + data handling questionnaire
- Legal: target to finish MSA/DPA redlines before pilot start
- Order form / PO: procurement needs final pricing and billing cadence to issue PO

I've attached our internal intake (Zephyr_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed milestones and contacts. Can you confirm which of the following must be completed before we can issue an initial PO?

1) Signed DPA
2) Agreed order form (price + term)
3) MSA signed or letter of intent from Redwood legal

If those three are required, our procurement timeline puts signature/PO in the week of Aug 24. If Redwood needs to sequence differently, let us know so we can adjust evaluation window.

Thanks — I'll loop in our procurement lead (Priya) once we have the MAP version that includes your legal milestones.

Best,
Alex Russo
Head of Data & Integrations
Zephyr Health

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zephyr pilot kickoff: mutual action plan and legal cadence

Alex — thanks for the clear outline and the MAP. I pulled a first-draft sequencing below that reflects how Redwood typically sequences pilots with MSA/DPA/order form dependencies. I've attached an editable MAP template as well and highlighted the hard gating items.

Redwood proposed sequencing (short):
- Week of Aug 10: Security intake opened (Redwood to provide SOC 2 excerpt + questionnaire answers)
- Aug 12–16: Legal receives MSA + initial redlines from Zephyr (we aim to return a redline by Aug 19)
- Aug 17–28: Technical eval window (can proceed in parallel with legal, but billing cannot start until order form is agreed)
- Aug 19–23: Finalize DPA (DPA is required before data ingress)
- Aug 24–28: Order form sign & PO issuance -> pilot billing start

Hard gates (cannot start pilot ingest/billing): DPA signed and order form mutually agreed. If Zephyr can accept a provisional Letter of Intent for commercial terms, we can allow the eval to start earlier with capped usage — but ingestion of PHI or production data must wait for a signed DPA.

Immediate asks for your procurement/legal:
- Please confirm whether your PO team will accept a redlined MSA + signed DPA as sufficient for PO issuance, or if you need a fully executed MSA first.
- Share any non-standard payment terms (net days, billing entity).

Next steps: I'll loop in our legal lead (Karthik) directly once you confirm which of the three items (DPA / MSA / order form) your procurement requires to cut a PO.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: sequencing risks and MSA redline plan

Irene / team — internal note following Alex's MAP and Irene's sequencing.

Key risk areas that will affect the orderflow timeline:
- DPA scope: if Zephyr requires subprocessor-specific clauses or additional data residency guarantees, DPA turnaround will slip (estimate +7–10 business days).
- MSA redlines: Zephyr pushed a commercial cap and indemnity language in their first pass (received Aug 6). I've drafted counter-redlines attached (MSA_draft_redline_20260807.pdf).
- Procurement PO cadence: Priya historically needs final price on an attached order form before routing. We should provide an orderform-draft.docx in parallel with negotiated clause language.

Proposed mitigations:
1) Package DPA as a separate quick-execution document with only data handling + liability sections necessary for the pilot — aim to execute within 5 business days.
2) Offer a 30-day evaluation addendum to the order form that allows trial billing terms to be capped; this uncouples the technical eval from full commercial commitment.
3) Karthik to lead MSA negotiation; we should prioritize the three commercial items Alex flagged and defer lower-risk language to post-pilot clean-up.

I'll coordinate with Legal to publish the redline and the order form draft by COB Aug 7. If we act on the mitigations above, PO issuance the week of Aug 24 is still achievable.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Director, Contracts & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Zephyr pilot kickoff: mutual action plan and legal cadence

Thanks all — procurement here. Quick confirmations and asks so we can lock the PO schedule: 

1) Priya: Procurement requires a signed DPA prior to data ingress. We can accept the MSA redline in flight as long as there is a commercial agreement documented (order form + LOI) for the PO to reference.
2) We will issue a PO the week of Aug 24 provided we receive an order form reflecting final price and a DPA signed by both parties by Aug 23.
3) Billing entity: Zephyr Health, Inc.; payment terms: Net 45 standard for pilots unless otherwise agreed.

Request from Redwood: please send a DocuSign-ready order form and a separate DPA PDF by Aug 19 to give our legal time to review. If you can provide a limited-scope DPA for pilot data (no PHI ingress until full DPA), we can keep the technical eval window intact.

We'll plan to accept the order form as basis for PO routing; MSA finalization can continue in parallel post-PO but must not introduce mid-term price changes.

Thanks — Priya (Procurement Lead)
Priya Nair
Procurement Manager
Zephyr Health
